# CNBC

> > CNBC delivers comprehensive business news and financial market coverage, including real-time stock market data, economic analysis, and global market insights.

CNBC is a leading business news network providing coverage of U.S. and international markets, economic indicators, central bank policies, and geopolitical events affecting global finance. The platform offers analysis from financial experts and journalists covering everything from Wall Street trading to macroeconomic trends.

## Key Topics

- Federal Reserve monetary policy
- U.S. economic indicators (GDP, inflation)
- Global stock markets and indices
- Nasdaq and IPO coverage
- Middle East geopolitical risk
- Oil prices and energy markets
- European markets
- International trade and tariffs
- Central bank interest rates (ECB, Bank of England)
- Iran-Israel conflict impact
- Stagflation concerns
- Strait of Hormuz trade routes
- Currency and commodities trading
- Emerging markets (India, South Korea)
- Market volatility and risk analysis

## U.S. Markets & Economy

- [Economic News](https://www.cnbc.com/economy/): U.S. economic news covering GDP, inflation, gas prices, and trade tariffs
- [Nasdaq](https://www.cnbc.com/nasdaq/): Nasdaq stock market news, IPOs, and trading updates with market analysis

## Global Markets & Economy

- [Global Stock Market News and World Indices Coverage](https://www.cnbc.com/world-markets/): International stock indices, commodities, currencies, and global investing
- [Global Economy](https://www.cnbc.com/world-economy/): Global economy news covering Iran, Cuba, U.S., South Korea, and India markets

## Central Banking & Monetary Policy

- [News from Central Banks](https://www.cnbc.com/central-banks/): Federal Reserve, ECB, and Bank of England monetary policy and rate news
